name: Physics Benchmarks for the ILC Detectors
description: This note presents a list of physics processes for benchmarking the performance of proposed ILC detectors. This list gives broad coverage of the required physics capabilities of the ILC experiments and suggests target accuracies to be achieved. A reduced list of reactions, which capture within a very economical set the main challenges put by the ILC physics program, is suggested for the early stage of benchmarking of the detector concepts.
reputation: A classic ILC detector physics reference used within the high-energy physics community for detector-performance benchmarking, though not a mainstream ML benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific physics benchmark; performance is usually reported as target-accuracy fulfillment on a curated set of processes rather than a single standardized leaderboard metric.
